book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: 1 Korin Pol pepa asamoll bolo dumo Korin una awi

content: Krais golo aglo erwo gun pi
Agana ambana kambono, asa na ye moi al wo God kandjiyebe wopake dje awill ye pi mal, na ye nomane to magno dje yell. Ye kandja ge wopake pille i pagle, aglo gi dje mor.
God yene kandjiyebe wopake paro ge, na kandja ge dje ye awill al ye amblo gi dji dal, God ye i yem woro natonda, mo ye pillgi kiwa dji dal, God embe nayenda.
Asa na kandja kerman ill mal, na ye moi al dje awill pora dji. Ge kandja embe mal pai. Baibel kandja dji mal pille, Krais nono djingne djangne kere auno dje pille goi.
Goika una ipo gull toi. Baibel dji mal pille ege sokara erwo pika, God i pla worika, erwo gun pi.
Po moika Pita kanika, are aposel 12 pela kani.
Are wo moika, agane ambane kambono merke ge, kuntaimane kune kani. Ge una 500 plato mal embe moi. Alla ipon kani una pende goi ba, merke molo par.
Are wo moika, Jems kanika, are aposel porapora kani.
Asamoll kanmaka alla are kaima nanam kanill. Na moll ge, na mana egena al nakui mal moll.
Una aposel moi al na are kaima moll. Ni aposel moren we dje una embe kaninj ba, na po God wombaye ye ke ye awill al, na kune namoro.

Na kune namoro ba God na wopake pille awi al na kune moro. Alla une na wopake pille awi ge, po kiwa napundo, man. Na kogo yembe yemolo, aposel kambono porapora i are worill. Ba na man, God na wopake pille awi al, na kogo embe yendo.
Embe yei pille, ga wo ye moi al kandja wopake dje awi, mo na wo ye dje awill ge wal kiwa. Wal kerman ge embe. God kandjiye wopake we dje ye aupin mal ye pillgi dji ge, wal kerman paro.
Una gor ge alla aglo erwo gun napine we djimaka, Pol man dji
No ye mor al kandja embe djinmon, Krais goi. Alla God i gun woro awi we djinmon. Ba ye una pende mor ge kandja embe djinj, una gor ge alla aglo erwo gun napinj we djinj. Ge namba yei pille djinj?
Una gor ge kaima aglo erwo gun napine we dji mal kaima paika, Krais para aglo erwo gun napika.
Krais golo aglo erwo gun napika, no kandja wopake dje ye aupin ge kandja kiwa djipinka. Alla ye pillgine ge wal kiwa yeika.
No God Krais i gun wori we dje kandja embe dje wanmopin ba una erwo gun napine we dji mal kandja kaima paika, no kandja kende mal embe djipinka. Alla God para Krais i gun nawori mal paika.
God una i gun naworda we djinj ge kandja kaima paika, God Krais i gun nawori mal embe yeika.
God Krais i gun nawori we djinj ge kandja kaima paika, ye pillgi djinj ge wal kiwa mal embe yeika. Alla ye yenekne djingne djangne al molo pamolmaka.
Alla una asa Krais kandjiye al pillgi dje molo po goi una, ga aike er take dje pumaka.
Nono manda makimb al molo Krais kandjiye pillgi djipin ba alla, are wor gun nambon ge, nono wandill mal mopon. Nono wandill una porapora are wori pora dji, nono tarowamo kaima yembon.

Ba una golo er gun napine we dje kandja embe djinj ge kende paro. God Krais i gun wori pora dji. Wal mau al bo to wekle are yendo mal ge, une asamoll aglo erwo gun pi, alla are una goye ge aglo erwo gun pineke yene.

Iwa Adam taimane molo singare ta yei al ge, makimb una molo gor. Yendo mal embe, ipon Krais taimane singare ta yei al ge, God nono amblo i pla wordaka, nono aglo erwo gun bon. Adam epilye mor ge, porapora molo gor. Gor mal embe ge, Krais epilye porapora mor ge, God i gun worda moye.
I gun worda ba, nono egene yenda kune nono i gun worda. Krais ge asamoll aglo erwo gun pi. Alla are, une yem wonda poke ge, nono Krais wombaye mormon ge aglo erwo gun bon.

Er wo gun bonaka, are ege pora djinda al wonda. Kune ge Krais yemolo gapman porapora ne, kum dongall ne, wal dongall porapora Krais kamblo kal woro kerda. Woro kere, are yene unakiye kantau yendo ge, une ga i yene Ne moya al awo kerda.
Ge Krais King molo pa pundaka, ege ta yenda kune, kundayem una kamblo kal worda.
Kundayem una porapora kamblo kal woro kere, alla are kaima une goi me ge kamblo kal worda.
Baibel kandja embe djindo,

content.text: God namba awika, une wal porapora kantau yendo we djindo (Buk Song 8.6)

content: (Krais wal porapora kantau yendo we dje Baibel kandja embe djindo ge, Krais yemolo God kantau yendo dje pille nadjindo. God yene moi ge une namba awika, Krais wal porapora kantau yendo.)

Alla are Krais wal porapora kamblo kal woro kerda kune ge, yene God wariye moro mal i menameto wordaka, Ne pla moya. Asa God yene wariye namba awika, Krais wal porapora kantau yei ba alla, Krais wo yene moro mal i menameto worda poke ge, kupill makimb yero al, God er plato po molo kerda.

Una golo aglo erwo gun napine we djinj ge kandja kaima paika, una gun mor nu pambonaka una goi una ge wopake moye dje pille nu par ge ale paika. Alla una golo par alla aglo erwo gun napine ge, una gor ge wopake moye dje pille nu par kambono ge, ga nu par ge ale yendo.
Alla no dumo yemyem wane po kandja ge dje una aupinka, una no togopon dje eri yei. Ba una golo aglo erwo gun napine we djinj ge kandja kaima paika, no kogo embe yepin al ge kogo kokas kulo yepinka.

Agana ambana kambono, na kandja kaima djindo, ege ege una na togopon dje yenj. Na kandja embe djindo ge, Iwa Kerman Jisas Krais ye boll kogo wopake yendo mal, na wopake kando pille na kandja embe djindo.
Una golo aglo erwo gun napine we djinj ge kandja kaima paika, na dumo Epesus molo una ke boll kunda yell ge kokas kulo yellka. Una golo par alla aglo erwo gun napine ge,

content.text: Nono kumaike gopon, ipon nono kwa no, nu no, nomane dall yembon we dji (Aisaia 22.13)

content: Una kandja embe djinj ge, ye yenekne kandja kende dje i djimbon dje yene. Nono una singare ke yenj una boll wanmopon ge, singare wopake yembon ge wo ke punda.
Ye dall nomane napanda, ye singare ke alla nayene. Pir mo? Ye una pende God nakaninj. Na kandja embe djindo ge, ye ngandjill goye dje pille djindo.
Nono golo aglo erwo gun bon ge, nono gaklene asa pai mal napanda, wor kaye ta mal punda
Una kandja embe djinj, una golo aglo erwo gun pine ba namba mal ye wo gun pine? Yenekne gaklene namba mal panda ne? djinj ba,
kandja djinj ge dall kandja djinj. Ye wal megiye makimb al yar ge, asamoll megiye ge goro. Alla are bolo pla punda.
Bolo pla po moya mal ye asamoll nayar, man. Ye asamoll megiye yar.
Yarka, God gakle gun aundo, yene nomane paro mal une aundaka, bolo pla punda. Megiye kayekaye paro mal pille, bolo pla po wal iko djelldjell boya.
Gaklene porapora wal taimane naparo. Una gaklene djell paraka, kog kena gaklene djell paraka, ka gaklene djell paraka, pis gaklene djell paraka yendo.
Kupill wal gaklene djell paraka, makimb wal gaklene djell paraka yendo.
Olpa ge, yene dondo mal dondaka, takene paro ge yene dondo mal dondaka, kam kandjip yene dondo mal dondaka yendo. Kam kandjip ta do talang we yendo, ta do talang kembis yendo.
Paro mal embe, una golo aglo erwo gun pinj ge embe mal yenj. Nono gormon gull tonj gaklene ge, wo ke pundo. Ba alla nono gaklene golo aglo erwo gun bon gaklene ge, wo ke punda naparo.

Nono gormon gull tonj gaklene ge kandjiye naparo ba alla, gaklene golo aglo erwo gun pine gaklene ge, kandjiye kerman panda. Nono gull tonmon gaklene ge yembe naparo ba alla, gaklene golo aglo erwo gun pine ge, yembe dongall panda.
Gaklene gull tonmon ge, makimb gaklene. Ba alla, gaklene golo aglo erwo gun pine ge, kupill gaklene. Makimb gaklene paraka kupill gaklene paraka yendo.
Baibel kandja embe bolo wori paro,

content.text: Asamoll moi iwa Adam ge, une gun moi una (Stat 2.7)

content: Alla, are moi iwa Krais ge, une awika una nomane gun pai.
Nono kupill gaklene asamoll napai. Asamoll makimb gaklene pai, are kupill gaklene panda.
Asamoll moi iwa ge, une makimb una moi, God makimb i pagle iwa ge beki. Ba alla are moi iwa ge, une kupill al una moi.
Makimb una porapora mor ge, Adam makimb gakle paro mal embe paro. Ba alla kupill al bon ge, Krais gakle paro ge, nono gaklene embe mal panda.
Ipon nono iwa Adam makimb una moi mal embe mormon ge, nono are iwa Krais kupill al una moro mal embe mopon.

Agana ambana kambono, na kandja dje ye aundo ge embe djindo, God dumoye wopake kantau yendo al ge, makimb una er pakna po wal wopake ine kondwe nayero. Makimb una gaklene wo ke pundo una mor ge, kupill al wal ine naparo. Kupill wal wo ke napunda pille, ga ine kune nayendo.
Pir mo? Kandja seke ta pai ge, na dje pene worna ye piye. Nono porapora nagopon, nono wo kaye ta mal po mopon.

Are kun taimanta, biugel tondaka, nalene kapilli tonmon mal, nono ola dje kaye ta mal mopon. Biugel tondaka, una asa goi ge God i pla wordaka, ga gaklene alla wo ke napunda, nono gaklene wo kaye ta mal punda mopon.
Embe mal paro. Gaklene wo ke pundo mal ge, alla nayenda, wo ta mal punda pille, kupill gaklene i mopon. Makimb gaklene paro mal ge, alla napanda, wo ta mal punda pille, gun eri molo pamopon.
Kune ge, nono gaklene wor ta mal punda pille, kupill gaklene i mopon, alla wo ta mal punda pille gun eri mopon poke ge, Baibel bolo wori pai ge kaima panda. Baibel kandja embe bolo wori pai,

content.text: Goi me ni moren ge, God to kal woro keri (Aisaia 25.8)
Goi me ge, ni una to kal worin mal embe ge, ipon pora djindo. Goi me ge, ni una ei togon mal ge, ipon pora dji (Hosea 13.14)

content: Goi me una ei bolo gor mal ge, djingdjang al bolo gor. Alla djingdjang yembe paro mal ge, kandja lo paro al ge, yembe paro.
Yembe paro ba nono God pille wopake we dje aunmon. Ge une yeworika nono Iwa Kerman Jisas Krais kogo yei al ge, nono goi me ge kunda yembe yepin pora dji.

Embe yei pille, agana ambana kambono ye wopake mor ge, ye Iwa Kerman kogoye yembe ye, aglo gi dje moye. Pir mo? Ye Iwa Kerman pille kogo dongall ye waninj kogo ge, kaima er take dje napunda. Embe yenda pille, Iwa Kerman kogo paro al ge, ye kogo yembe yene.
